# Manish Bisht

> Staff Engineer with a decade across product, platform, and engineering
> leadership — from founding Run4Offers to leading teams at VideoVerse. Works
> backwards from the customer problem, ships the smallest thing that solves it,
> and builds the engineering rigour to make it last. Currently applying that to
> AI-assisted products and workflows. Based in India (IST).

Personal portfolio at https://manishbisht.me. Static React app on GitHub
Pages. The home page is pre-rendered to HTML at build time, so it is readable
without JavaScript; this file is the condensed text summary.

## Quick facts

- Role: Staff Engineer at VideoVerse (since January 2025; Lead Engineer there
  in 2024). Based in India, works remotely.
- Earlier: Let's Dive (founding engineer, SDE II, 2020–2023; acquired by VideoVerse), BookMyShow (SDE, 2019–2020),
  Covalent Capital (Software Engineer, 2018–2019), BlueCube Network (intern,
  2016), founder of Run4Offers (2015).
- Specialisms: platform and distributed systems (microservices, event-driven
  architecture on SNS/SQS, serverless on AWS Lambda and Cloud Run);
  observability and incident response (Datadog, Last9, tracing, PagerDuty);
  CI/CD, release engineering, and developer productivity (Playwright,
  SonarQube, feature flags); React, TypeScript, Node.js; AI-assisted
  engineering workflows.
- Notable results (VideoVerse unless noted): incident acknowledgment cut from
  20–30 min to under 2 min across 30+ services; ~60% observability cost
  reduction (Datadog → Last9); biweekly → daily production releases for a
  ~20-engineer team; V2 platform modernisation serving 100+ enterprise
  customers and 550K+ clips/month; ~7M media lifecycle events/month on an
  SNS/SQS architecture; mobile server errors down 94% (BookMyShow); production
  build size down 85% (Covalent Capital).
- Education: B.Tech in Information Technology, Swami Keshvanand Institute of
  Technology (2014–2018).
- Open source: Google Summer of Code 2017 (phpMyAdmin core); Facebook Open
  Source mentorship 2018 (Facebook Instant Articles).
- Availability: open to staff / principal engineering roles, selective
  freelance, and consulting. Replies within 24 hours.
